label: Dog or cat import quarantine — application fee
appliesTo: The Korean government fee only. Microchipping, vaccination, antibody testing, the exporting government's certificate, the airline and any corrective work after arrival are all separate and larger.
why: Quoted as the cost of bringing a pet to Korea, when it is the smallest number in the relocation. The expensive outcomes — detention, corrective testing, return — come from paperwork, not from this fee.
